description: This file contains the implementation of a binary data reader for the Orleans.Serialization library, including abstract input interfaces, stream-based input, and a generic reader struct supporting various buffer types and reading methods.

classes.name: ReaderInput
classes.description: Abstract interface for binary data input sources, providing methods for reading bytes, seeking, and skipping.

classes.name: StreamReaderInput
classes.description: Implementation of ReaderInput that reads data from a Stream, supporting byte reading, seeking, and skipping.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory methods to create a Reader for various input types such as buffers, streams, sequences, and spans.

methods.name: ReadByte
methods.description: Reads a single byte from the input, with support for different input types.

methods.name: ReadUInt32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit unsigned integer from the input, using little-endian byte order.

methods.name: ReadUInt64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit unsigned integer from the input, using little-endian byte order.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a specified number of bytes in the input.

methods.name: ForkFrom
methods.description: Creates a new Reader instance starting at a specified position, useful for parsing sub-segments.

methods.name: ResumeFrom
methods.description: Resumes reading from a specific position after a forked reader is no longer in use.

methods.name: ReadBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes into a span or array, supporting multi-segment buffers.

methods.name: TryReadBytes
methods.description: Attempts to read a specified number of bytes without advancing the position, returning success status.

methods.name: ReadVarUInt32
methods.description: Reads a variable-length encoded unsigned 32-bit integer.

methods.name: ReadVarUInt64
methods.description: Reads a variable-length encoded unsigned 64-bit integer.
